title: Sagres
intro: Sagres is the southwesternmost point of Portugal and of Europe, in Barlavento, western Algarve, a beach destination with some nice churches, lighthouses and forts.

sections.title: Overview
sections.html: Sagres is the southwesternmost point of Portugal and of Europe, in Barlavento, western Algarve, a beach destination with some nice churches, lighthouses and forts.

sections.title: Understand
sections.html: Sagres (/ˈsa.gɾɨʃ/, SAH-gr(ih)sh) is a civil parish in the municipality of Vila do Bispo. It is the alleged location of the nautical school first developed by Prince Henry the Navigator in the early 1400s. The school itself is vanished; In May 1587, Sir Francis Drake disembarked 800 men who assaulted the Sagres fortress. After two hours of intense combat, the fortress was destroyed and its artillery was pillaged. Salema is also in Vila do Bispo municipality.

sections.title: Visitor information
sections.html: • Posto de Turismo, Avenida Comandante Matoso, ☏ +351 282 624 873.  (updated Jun 2021)

sections.title: By plane
sections.html: Faro international airport (FAO IATA), the second busiest in Portugal, is the only airport in the Algarve region.

sections.title: By rail
sections.html: The nearest train service is at Lagos from Faro, which offers connections to Vila Real de Santo António, Lisbon and beyond.

sections.title: By bus
sections.html: Eva Transportes route 47 provides bus service from Lagos to several localities in Vila do Bispo, including Salema, Sagres, and Cabo São Vicente.

sections.title: By car
sections.html: The EN268 road connects many locations in the municipality including Vila do Bispo town, Sagres, and Cabo São Vicente.

sections.title: See
sections.html:
• Fortaleza de Sagres (Castelo de Sagres, Forte de Sagres). Daily, 9:30–17:30 October–April, 9:30–20:00 May–September, closed on 1 January, Easter Sun, 1 May, and 25 December; last admission is 30 minutes before closing. A 15th-century military fortress, classified as a national monument. Tickets are sold only at the gate; there is no official online ticket sales system. 10€, children under 12 enter free. 
  • Ponta de Sagres (Sagres Point). A promontory on the Atlantic Ocean. 
  • Cape of St. Vincent (Cabo São Vicente). Europe's southwestern corner. 
  • Lighthouse.  (updated Nov 2020)

sections.title: Eat
sections.html:
• Pizzaria Colombus, Rua S. Vicente (Praça republica-mareta), ☏ +351 282 624 646. Mon–Wed Sat 12:00–16:00 & 18:00–02:00, Thu Fri 12:00–02:00, closed Sun. Homemade pizzas, cocktails, breakfast. (updated Apr 2021)
  • Bossa Nova Pizzeria, Rua Comandante Matoso, ☏ +351 282 624 566, dromedariosagres@gmail.com. Tue–Sun 17:00–23:00, closed Mon. The best pizzas in town. (updated Apr 2021)

sections.title: Drink
sections.html:
Sagres is also the name of a very common beer in Portugal. If you haven't had one yet, try it here.

  • aSagres Restaurante, Avenida Infante D.Henrique, Sítio do Tonel, ☏ +351 282 624 171, info@restauranteasagres.com.  (updated Apr 2021)
  • Dromedário Bar, Rua Comandante Matoso, ☏ +351 282 624 219. 12:00–03:00 daily.  (updated Apr 2021)
  • Água Salgada, Rua Comandante Matoso, ☏ +351 282 624 297. Tue–Sun 10:00–02:00, closed Mon.  (updated Apr 2021)

sections.title: Sleep
sections.html:
• Mareta Beach Boutique Bed and Breakfast, Praça da República, ☏ +351 282 620 040, info@sagresholidays.com. Has 18 double rooms fully equipped with air conditioning, plasma tv with satellite, minibar, phone and en-suite bathroom, 14 of them also have sea views. 
  • Mareta View Boutique Bed and Breakfast, Beco D. Henrique, ☏ +351 282 620 000, info@sagresholidays.com. Overlooks the white sand of Mareta beach. 
  • Memmo Baleeira, Sítio da Baleeira (near the port of Baleeira), ☏ +351 282 624 212, baleeira@memmohotels.com. Nice and clean design hotel in Sagres with ocean views. 
  • Navigator Beach & Nature Hotel (Hotel Apartamentos), Rua Infante D. Henrique, ☏ +351 282 624 354, info.navigator@gschotel.com. Side by side to Pousada. 
  • Pousada Sagres, Ponta da Atalaia, ☏ +351 282 620 240, fax: +351 282 624 225, recepcao.infante@pousadas.pt. Nice position on the cliff-top overlooking Sagres Fort and the lighthouse of Cape St Vicent. 
  • Residência Quinta do Poço, N268, ☏ +351 917720875, residenciaquintapoco@gmail.com. Calm and relaxing vibe. Double with bathroom €30.

sections.title: Connect
sections.html: As of Jan 2025, Sagres and its approach roads have 4G from Digi and MEO, and 5G from NOS and Vodafone.
